reviews.text:
We have been using Sun Valley Pools for several of my properties and couldn't be be happier!
Nathan and Patrick are fantastic -- Professionally, friendly, and consistently reliable. They always go above and beyond to make sure everything is perfect,
The service is not only top - quality but also very personable. It is clear they genuinely care about their customers.
Highly recommend to anyone looking for dependable, friendly, and expert pool care! 5 stars al the way!!!
Thanks
Raj
reviews.author: Rajjj Patelll

reviews.text:
We paid for pool cleaning services in additional to multiple "repairs" this past year only to be told by another company that our pool is in "horrible" condition with MANY critical issues that will need to be fixed (pump was almost burn up due to 2 leaks) and it needs major deep cleaning (there are tons of dirt and debris).  They also found multiple UNDISSOLVED chlorine tablets in the bottom of our pool.  We were not informed about any of these issues and had assumed the pool was being taken care of.  AVOID this company.  We are not sure what we paid for.

1 star simply because they agreed to discontinue our service moving forward and not charge us for service in the last month, but we are very upset.  We are first-time pool owners and were completely ignorant.  We needed professional guidance and help but instead feel preyed upon.
reviews.author: Thanh Lam

reviews.text: Recently just switched from my long term mediocre pool service company to Sun Valley. I can't tell you how satisfied I am with the results. The pics in this review are from July 9th old company's work on my pool. The clean perfect pool picture is from July 11th the results from Sun Valley who fixed all the problems my last pool company left us with. THANK YOU SUN VALLEY! You basically saved our Summer.
reviews.author: Sabrina Neugent

reviews.text: Great service, communication and love our pool tech. We have a challenging pool (a lot of leaves!) and Sun Valley keeps our water clean and clear all year. Client for over 10 years.
reviews.author: Bbd Jjd

reviews.text: I have used at least three other pool service until I found Sun valley and I am not one to write reviews but these guys are amazing, they always respond and show up when they say.  Best pool service by far!
reviews.author: Terri Melton

reviews.text: We have been using Sun Valley for about a year now and they have given us great pool service and customer service.  Our service tech always does a great job cleaning the pool.  We had some repairs that needed to be done to the pool equipment and he did an expert job.  Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Perry Maxwell

reviews.text:
New to the Arlington area, Sun Valley has been awesome.
Very professional, were on time, and great price.
Nathan was also so friendly along with being accolading to questions/concerns.
Great Company...5 stars for sure!
reviews.author: afi team

reviews.text:
Sun Valley Pool Service is a credit to the industry.  I had three different companies recommended to service our over sized pool.  The difference with Sun Valley, Customer service is #1.  The other service providers sent a technician with no experience, another could not keep commitments to delivery of service, two cancellation and requested a third extension and it goes on.  Sun Valley, after listening to our nightmare and our pool not being available for our grand children's visit without hesitation delivered.  Courteous, prompt, and experienced technician solved the issues on time promised and fixed the issue immediately with no issues.  Amazing.  I tip my hat to this company and look forward to continued service and maintenance.

Roy and Diane Castillo - Burleson, TX
reviews.author: Diane Castillo

data.summary: The reviews appear largely authentic. The positive reviews are consistent and plausible. However, the single 1-star review is extremely severe, detailed, and credible, alleging significant negligence, failure to communicate, and effectively billing for services not rendered, which targeted vulnerable first-time pool owners. This creates a high-risk pattern despite the overall positive rating.
fake_signals: One 5-star review uses a generic name ('Bbd Jjd') and lacks specific personal details, though the content is plausible.
The 5-star reviews are overwhelmingly positive with very similar, effusive language about professionalism and reliability.

damning_quotes.quote: We paid for pool cleaning services in additional to multiple 'repairs' this past year only to be told by another company that our pool is in 'horrible' condition with MANY critical issues that will need to be fixed (pump was almost burn up due to 2 leaks) and it needs major deep cleaning (there are tons of dirt and debris).
They also found multiple UNDISSOLVED chlorine tablets in the bottom of our pool. We were not informed about any of these issues and had assumed the pool was being taken care of.
We are first-time pool owners and were completely ignorant. We needed professional guid[ance]...
We are not sure what we paid for.

authentic_signals: The 1-star review is highly detailed, specific (mentions undissolved chlorine tablets, a near-burned-up pump, leaks), and narrates a coherent, damaging story.
Multiple 5-star reviews mention specific employee names (Nathan, Patrick) and specific, plausible scenarios (switching from a mediocre company, challenging pool with leaves, being new to the area).
The 5-star review from 'Diane Castillo' is cut off mid-sentence, which is a common, authentic artifact of review platforms.
The negative review expresses a nuanced reason for the 1-star rating (company agreed to discontinue service without charging for the last month), which adds credibility.

complaint_patterns.pattern: Selling service not rendered / billing for work not done

data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one platform (Google) provides review data. Both the HQ and local listings show identical ratings (4.2★ from 31 reviews), indicating consistency. The 8 reviews analyzed here are a subset of the total 31.
